notes: Verdict: no convincing backdoor evidence in the inspected weights, not a proof of absence. Embedding norms have median 0.5696, 99th percentile 0.9781 and maximum 1.1969 (token 789), with no isolated extreme norm. Direct and linear MLP virtual class paths have multiple comparable leaders across different classes. MLP fc1/fc2 top singular-value energy fractions are 0.265/0.231; classifier fraction is 0.270, and classifier row norms range 1.530 to 2.064. Head 0 OV has top singular-value energy fraction 0.955, but its effective read direction aligns with the earlier-versus-last positional difference at absolute cosine 0.968. The first three positional embeddings differ by only 0.096-0.130 in Euclidean norm, versus 0.965-0.985 from the last position. This supports shared positional processing, not a unique trigger. Attention token-key rankings have several near-tied leaders, not a unique universal attractor. Centered unit-embedding virtual OV class scores have maximum absolute values 0.1815 and 0.0272 for heads 0 and 1, versus 3.8922 for the direct path; these are algebraic comparisons, not actual logits or behavioral bounds. Token 227 was investigated because it has the most isolated centered embedding direction (nearest cosine 0.7616) and maximizes neuron 15 alignment. However, its direct class direction favors class 3, its linear MLP route favors class 6, and its class-9 route is weaker than multiple ordinary peers; this does not support a coherent class-9 override. No unique token/target/pathway convergence was found. All calculations used state_dict geometry, SVD, embedding-direction similarities and virtual matrix/bilinear paths. LayerNorm centering and learned scales were included in selected paths, but activation-dependent variance normalization, GELU gating, attention softmax and full sequence behavior were not evaluated. Calibration is within-checkpoint comparison across vocabulary rows, classes, heads and neurons; no clean checkpoint, reference training distribution, task labels or calibrated statistical null was available. Confidence is a heuristic judgment, not a measured probability. In particular, a malicious last-token label remapping can be indistinguishable from ordinary token-to-class lookup weights without a clean reference. No model edits were justified or made.
